rules: NO INTER for headings. Use Playfair Display for a masculine, premium serif feel.
Headings (Size > 32px) MUST use tight letter spacing (tracking-tight).
Overlines and Labels MUST be Uppercase + Tiny + Wide Spacing (tracking-[0.2em]).
Line Height: Tight (leading-none) for headers, Loose (leading-relaxed) for body.
Use fluid typography scaling (text-4xl to text-6xl max for heroes).
NO pure black (#000000) or pure white (#FFFFFF) for backgrounds.
NO purple/violet 'AI slop' gradients. Stick to solid dark grays (Graphite) with Soft Gold accents.
Focus on contrast and hierarchy using different shades of graphite.

visual_enhancers.textures: Apply a subtle noise/grain overlay (CSS radial-gradient + noise SVG filter) to the Hero and main dark surfaces to avoid digital flatness.
visual_enhancers.neumorphism: Soft Neumorphism (Neumorphism suave) - achieve this through layered, diffuse dark shadows (e.g., shadow-[4px_4px_10px_#0d0d10,-4px_-4px_10px_#1b1b24]) combined with a 1px crisp inner border (border-white/5) for definition.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Use for the sticky mobile CTA, floating contact buttons, and fixed navigation (backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#14141A]/80 with border-white/5).
visual_enhancers.borders: Always use 1px solid subtle borders on cards to ground them; do not rely solely on shadows.

layouts.marketing_public: Mobile-first. Asymmetrical bento grids for galleries and services. Generous spacing (p-12 to p-24). Large, edge-to-edge photography in hero. Include a persistent/sticky 'RESERVAR CITA' CTA at the bottom for mobile.
layouts.booking_wizard: Frictionless multi-step flow (Service -> Date -> Time -> Details/Policy). Clean, zero distractions. Keep interactions to maximum 3-4 taps.
layouts.admin_dashboard: High-density grid setup (Grid Mode B). Sharp functional UI. Cardless or minimal-border styling for tables/calendars (Day/Week/Month). Optimize for speed and readability.

components.buttons: Primary CTA must be Soft Gold (#D4B77A) with dark graphite text. Sharp or slightly rounded corners (rounded-md), not fully pill-shaped. Add micro-interactions (scale-down on active, glow on hover).
components.cards: Services and Testimonial cards should have a flat graphite background (#1A1A1E), a 1px border (#2A2A32), and lift slightly on hover.
components.booking_elements: Use customized Shadcn UI primitives (Calendar, Select, Form). Restyle them to remove default Vercel aesthetic, applying the Graphite/Gold palette.

motion.marketing: Lenis smooth scrolling. Subtle parallax on the hero image. Staggered fade-up entrances for the services bento grid.
motion.interactions: Micro-animations on hover/click for all buttons and cards. Use Framer Motion for smooth lateral slide transitions in the booking wizard.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text over images uses dark gradients or backdrop filters to maintain APCA readability standards. Never use fully transparent backgrounds where text exists.
accessibility.testing: CRITICAL: All interactive elements, inputs, and key informational nodes MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., `data-testid="book-appointment-btn"`).

instructions_to_main_agent: The project uses React/Vite with JavaScript (.js/.jsx), NOT TypeScript. Output all code in standard JS.
Establish two distinct routing zones: The public marketing/booking side (/) and the private admin dashboard (/admin).
Inject a floating WhatsApp/Instagram contact button on the public pages.
The hero section needs the main 'RESERVAR CITA' (Book Appointment) CTA heavily emphasized. Make it sticky on mobile.
Implement the 3-step booking wizard seamlessly (can be a modal or dedicated route).
Embed a Google Maps iframe for Tenerife in the location section.
For the admin panel, include a calendar view (Day/Week/Month), schedule settings, CRUD for services, and a client list.
Use 'Europe/Madrid' timezone logic where applicable, and EUR currency.
Everything must be localized to Spanish.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: `transition: all`. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add `.App { text-align: center; }`.
Always use modern button styles like sharp or slightly rounded with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states are highly encouraged.
Main agent relies on image URLs. Missing categories = placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN. Use the provided image_urls.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
